segments.t: Welcome back to House Arrest. Its hero, Arkady Anikeev, was the mayor of the small Russian town of Sineozersk until he was caught taking a bribe and placed under house arrest in the noisy communal flat where he grew up, right next door to his childhood bully Samson. In the fourth episode, Arkady and his slick Moscow campaign strategist Ilona launched Samson's campaign for mayor against Arkady's scheming deputy Pasha, only for tipsy Samson to take a luxury car on a test drive and crash it straight into a building at the end of the night. We open at the crash site as traffic police make drunken Samson breathe into a breathalyser tube, and then cut back to the communal flat where Arkady and Ilona watch the breaking news report in horror. We'll hear it in Russian first; don't worry about catching every word.
Что я пил? Шипучку!
Надо дышать? В трубку дышать?
Отпустите, пожалуйста! Отпустите меня!
Три с половиной промилле? У меня семь кредитов!
Нет, не надо! Дань, ну скажи им!
Смотри новости!
У общества слепых произошла страшная авария!
На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
Там начался пожар! Везде пожарные машины и полиция!
Ну что я тебе скажу, Аркаша? Это полный кошмар!
Вот я дура! Надо было работать на Осипенко.
Тихо, тихо! Ещё не всё потеряно!
Let's go back through the scene step by step. Outside the damaged building of the Sineozersk Society for the Blind, police officers hold a breathalyser tube up to Samson's face.
Что я пил? Шипучку!
'What was I drinking? Fizzy wine!' The word Samson uses for sparkling wine comes from the verb 'to fizz' and is in the accusative case after the verb 'was drinking'.
Надо дышать? В трубку дышать?
'Do I have to breathe? Breathe into the tube?' Literally 'it is necessary to breathe', followed by the preposition 'into' with the accusative case of 'little tube'.
Отпустите, пожалуйста! Отпустите меня!
'Let me go, please! Let me go!' He uses the polite plural imperative of the perfective verb 'to let go'.
Три с половиной промилле?
'Three and a half per mille?' Per mille is parts per thousand of blood alcohol — three and a half is an enormous reading. Notice the instrumental case after 'with': 'three with a half'.
У меня семь кредитов!
'I have seven loans!' After numbers from five upwards, Russian nouns take the genitive plural. As the police lead him away, Samson calls out to his lawyer friend Danila Golovkin.
Нет, не надо! Дань, ну скажи им!
'No, don't! Danya, come on, tell them!' Danila tries to intervene, while back at the communal flat Arkady and Ilona stare at the television screen.
Смотри новости!
'Look at the news!' Arkady points at the screen.
У общества слепых произошла страшная авария!

'A terrible crash happened at the Society for the Blind!' The preposition for 'by' or 'at' takes the genitive case of 'society', and 'of the blind' is the genitive plural of the adjective used as a noun.
На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
'At huge speed the car crashed into the building!' Notice how 'on huge speed' uses the prepositional case, while 'into the building' uses the accusative case for motion into a place.
Там начался пожар! Везде пожарные машины и полиция!
'A fire started there! Fire engines and police are everywhere!' Literally 'fire machines and police'. Ilona buries her face in her hands.
Ну что я тебе скажу, Аркаша?
'Well, what can I tell you, Arkasha?' She uses the perfective future 'what will I say to you' and the warm diminutive of Arkady's name.
Это полный кошмар!
'This is a total nightmare!' And she regrets turning down Mayor Pasha Osipenko.
Вот я дура!
'What a fool I am!' Literally 'here I am a fool'.
Надо было работать на Осипенко.
'I should have worked for Osipenko.' Literally 'it was necessary to work on Osipenko' — working for a boss uses the preposition 'on' with the accusative case.
Тихо, тихо! Ещё не всё потеряно!
'Easy, easy! Not everything is lost yet!' Literally 'quietly, quietly', using the short passive participle 'lost' in the neuter form. Now let's hear the whole opening scene again from the start.
Что я пил? Шипучку!
Надо дышать? В трубку дышать?
Отпустите, пожалуйста! Отпустите меня!
Три с половиной промилле? У меня семь кредитов!
Нет, не надо! Дань, ну скажи им!
Смотри новости!
У общества слепых произошла страшная авария!
На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
Там начался пожар! Везде пожарные машины и полиция!
Ну что я тебе скажу, Аркаша? Это полный кошмар!
Вот я дура! Надо было работать на Осипенко.
Тихо, тихо! Ещё не всё потеряно!

So Samson's test drive has ended inside the wall of the Society for the Blind, and Ilona thinks their campaign for mayor is finished. Next we'll join Arkady, Ilona, and Nina in the kitchen the next morning; see you there.
Это полный кошмар!
